# agent-checkpoint

> Checkpoint and resume agent runs from an append-only JSONL log: recorded steps replay without re-execution, divergence detection, torn-tail recovery and terminal states Python package `trysac-agent-checkpoint`, import name `agent_checkpoint`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
